status_at_snapshot.expected_warning_policy: Bounded-excerpt notices are retained; all other answer warnings fail the run
status_at_snapshot.gap_interpretation: An oversized wall gap may be sleep, clock change or slow work; none is treated as uninterrupted coverage
status_at_snapshot.resource_scope: Sampled RSS/lifetime CPU of persistent MCP only, excluding writer/model daemons; no power estimate
status_at_snapshot.scope: Persistent MCP client/server, concurrent CLI writer, keyword/full/preview retrieval, complete source reads, erasure and optional local Qwen answers. No capture/device/UI/power/competitor claim.

limits: Early running snapshot only. Not a 24-hour result or ongoing liveness proof; verify controller/MCP processes and sample freshness locally. Full capture/power/fault gates remain open.
